notes.title: 4 Playable GameModes - New Beta Round
notes.content:
[h2]New Beta round![/h2]

This weekend will be the last Beta round of 2020. 

For this weekend you have [b]4 Gamemodes and 2 maps![/b]

The 4 Gamemodes are:
- Capture The Ray
- Team Deathmatch
- Keep the Ray 
- And the new and original gamemode: Module Rush

Capture the Ray has its own specific maps, and the other 3 GamesModes are played on the second map.

The default servers will all feature Module Rush. In order to play the other Gamemodes you have to create a new [b]custom game[/b].

The Cubes available in multiplayer this weekend are the Cube LINE and ONESHOT.

Merry Christmas and happy new year to all!

notes.title: Clans arrive - New Open Beta Round
notes.content:
[h2]New Beta round weekend, servers just opened![/h2]

This weekend there is a [b]new GameMode[/b] plus we are joined by [b]3 gaming communities[/b] that will try the game!

If you want to play Firing Vibes with them you can join their Discord server and check when they are playing.

The Fallen Fews: [url=https://discord.gg/cgT2A2Q]https://discord.gg/cgT2A2Q[/url]
Outlawz: [url=https://discord.com/invite/6YybQfR]https://discord.com/invite/6YybQfR[/url]
Team Saiyan: [url=https://discord.gg/a7g7FPQ]https://discord.gg/a7g7FPQ[/url]

Edit: A 4th Community will finally join, Caustic Gaming: [url=https://discord.gg/73vJfW2]https://discord.gg/73vJfW2[/url]

[h3]Patchnote:[/h3]
- New GameMode: [b]Keep The Ray[/b]. In this gamemode (more commonly called Oddball) there is one objective to capture and keep for a total of 9 minutes to win the game.
- The mouse sensitivity settings are fixed.
- Cube LINE and cube ONESHOT are the default cubetypes available this weekend.

notes.title: Slow Weekend - New Open Beta Round
notes.content:
[h2]This weekend Servers open again![/h2]

And there is a new type of cube available, the cube FLOWER!

However there are still very few players so it's complicated to find games. But work is being done to hopefully have more players next weekend!

Still you can try the new type if cube. There are also a few other changes and fixes, you can find more details on the [url=https://discord.gg/5CN3KwF]Discord Server[/url].

And we again have the weekly meetup this Saturday at 8PM UTC to crowd the servers and play full games!

notes.title: New Beta Round This weekend with a New Map + Meetup this Saturday 28 at 8PM UTC
notes.content:
[h2]A new Open Beta round is starting this weekend with the servers opening as this news is published![/h2]

[h3]And this weekend you will be able to play [b]Team Deathmatch[/b] on a [b]fresh new map[/b]![/h3]

But as there is only a few people who know about the game for now it's still hard to find other players to play with. So we did a poll in the [url=https://discord.gg/5CN3KwF]Discord[/url] to know when most people can play so we can play together!

It turns out it will be the Saturday the most of you can play. So we can all try to play this 28th of November.

And to be sure to have full games it's even better to select a precise hour to gather. So let's all meetup [b]this saturday[/b] at [b]8PM UTC[/b]!(equivalent in your timezone [url=https://www.google.com/search?q=8%3A00PM+utc+in+my+time]https://www.google.com/search?q=8%3A00PM+utc+in+my+time[/url]) and play some games together!

notes.title: Firing Vibes Open Beta weekends starts 20th of November!
notes.content:
Firing Vibes is entering [b]Open Beta this Friday the 20th[/b] of November. The Servers will be open every weekend for one month! (maybe more) Come try the game!

Every weekend the server will open the Friday at 8PM UTC and close the Monday at 8AM UTC.


Also
Because it is an indie multiplayer game it can be hard to find a full lobby of players to play with. So if you want to be sure to find a match please everyone interested come [b]every Sunday at 8PM UTC[/b] to play some matches together!

For more informations about the Beta and the game you can join the Discord [url=https://discord.gg/5CN3KwF]https://discord.gg/5CN3KwF[/url]

notes.title: Video Guide explaining the 4 Gameplay Pillars
Play session rendez-vous this Sunday 11th at 4PM UTC
notes.content: Firing Vibes is a multiplayer only game and it needs 4 people to launch a full game and truly experience the game. So everyone interested can Download the Demo available for the Steam autumn Festival and log in around 4PM UTC this sunday 11th to play multiplayer matches!

notes.title: Firing Vibes - How to play the game guide
notes.content:
With plenty of unique gameplay mechanics. It can be complicated to understand how to play the game at the beginning. This short video guide covers the basics of the 4 core gameplay mechanics the game features plus the primary gamemode.

Also as there needs to be 4 players to start a proper game. To ensure having sufficient players a rendez-vous is set for tomorrow Sunday the 11th at 4PM UTC. please come around this time if you can to experience full Firing Vibes games!

notes.title: A free Demo/Beta is playable from now until the 13th of October
notes.content:
Firing Vibes is part of the Steam Autumn Festival. And Until the 13th of october the game is playable with open online servers in Europe, North America and East Asia.

As the game is in a Beta State you will likely encounter some bugs. If you need support or want to report a bug or provide feedback please join the Discord Server!
[url=https://invite.gg/firingvibes]https://invite.gg/firingvibes[/url]
